config.description: Method replication: the images are new Baidu street views of central Shanghai (inside the Outer Ring), taken along the road direction, not the paper's stimuli. Participants look at each street view for at least 30 seconds and rate the 12 statements of the psychological stress perception scale (relaxation, safety, familiarity, crowding, stayability) from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree), as in Zhang, Wang, Zhang, Hu & Zhang (2024, Frontiers in Public Health). The paper reversed the positive items and combined the five factors into one stress score with weights. Differences from the original study: (1) 25 images per participant instead of 50; (2) the paper's 32 volunteers were half local and half non-local residents, recorded here with a residence question.

paper.title: Assessing the nonlinear impact of green space exposure on psychological stress perception using machine learning and street view images
